analyst: The script is a strategy that trades only while its session filter is active and closes all positions when that condition fails. It opens a long with strategy.entry("Long", strategy.long) when a pivot low is present and RSI moves above 30, and it opens a short with strategy.entry("Short", strategy.short) when a pivot high is present and RSI moves below 70. Each position is managed by strategy.exit using long_stop or short_stop, which are built from the stop_dollars input divided by the point value, along with a take-profit limit. It also closes all positions if the open profit reaches the negative stop_dollars level.
